title: Hot forging + thread rolling of all rotor & caliper bolts
description: Hot forging + thread rolling of all rotor & caliper bolts capability for titanium components
processDescription: Thread rolling cold-forms threads by displacing material between two reciprocating or rotary dies, rather than cutting it away. Compressive residual stress at the thread root increases fatigue strength by 30–50% compared to cut threads, specifically for titanium components. Precision titanium components present unique challenges: Balancing dimensional accuracy with cost per part. Process selection (mill vs. turn vs. EDM vs. laser) optimized for each feature.
heatControl: Cold forming process — no heat generated. Water-soluble lubricant applied to dies for galling prevention on titanium.
flatnessControl: Head flatness and perpendicularity within 0.05 mm per fastener standards. Die alignment verified with optical setup microscope.
capabilitiesDescription: Hydraulic and mechanical press capability for Hot forging + thread rolling of all rotor & caliper bolts, with induction heating, die temperature control, and grain flow optimization.
